raw_segments.text: I have thus a tight shingled and plastered house, ten feet wide by fifteen long, and
eight feet posts, with a garret and a closet, a large window on each side, two trap doors,
one door at the end, and a brick fireplace opposite.
The exact cost of my house, paying the usual price for such materials as I used, but not
counting the work, all of which was done by myself, was as follows.
And I give the details because very few are able to tell exactly what their houses cost,
and fewer still, if any, the separate cost of the various materials which compose them.
